from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyShareRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted share count data for a single company from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as identified in the document")
    share_count: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of shares or units outstanding")
    unit_type: str | None = Field(description="The unit of measurement (e.g., 'shares', 'units')")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The date associated with this outstanding count")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_shares: list[CompanyShareRecord]
